items.textToSpeech: For males aged 18+ living a moderately active lifestyle, the Average Requirements for energy reduce with age and range from 2,675 kilocalories per day for those aged 18-29, to 2,269 kilocalories per day for those aged 70-79. Average Requirements for energy were not calculated for adults aged 80+ because of a lack of anthropometric data from EU countries for this age group. See the associated table or the source document for full details.

The Average Requirement is the level of nutrient intake estimated to satisfy the physiological requirement or metabolic demand in half of the people in a population group, given a normal distribution of requirement. Is there anything else I can help you with?
